Because the log nevertheless claims the matrix is checked, the missing preflight is an incomplete gate claim. Add the Matrix coherence preflight row with the six-check audit summary or a valid Not applicable rationale.

findings.title: Use finding-result availability, not publication, as the terminal-failure outcome boundary
findings.body: Implementation Order step 4, the Code Samples, Testing Strategy scenario 5, and the smoke runbook Assertions Checklist AC1 all say that a terminal failure before publication records not_determined, and only post-publication failures record produced_findings or produced_none. Spec AC1 says not_determined belongs only to failures that leave the finding result unestablished; where the finding result exists but publication has not happened, the pass should record ordinary produced_findings/produced_none values, with logs-only surface placement when no review-outcome check run exists. Fix the plan, tests, and runbook to use result availability as the outcome boundary and publication only as a surface-placement rule.

findings.title: Reconcile the mandatory matchTerms field with the spec
findings.body: Recorded artifacts, the sweep-categories validator, classifyFindings, Testing Strategy scenario 8, and smoke runbook Step 11 all make matchTerms a required category field and make missing or empty matchTerms malformed. Spec AC4 and AC19 define category fields and malformed conditions without matchTerms, and the spec's initial category table does not fix matchTerms. This adds an operator-facing list requirement and a degradation path the specification does not describe, and it makes category membership depend on substrings rather than the recorded failure shapes. Remove matchTerms as a mandatory/validation field, or otherwise reconcile the plan with the specified category fields and AC19 malformed domains.

findings.title: Define per-finding category attribution for AC9 and AC20
findings.body: AC9 requires each sweep-on unexpected precision finding to be attributed to its category, categories, or uncategorized, and AC20 requires every published finding to appear in the per-category record. The plan's SweepPassRecord and classifyFindings return only per-category outcomes plus an uncategorizedFindingCount, with no finding-to-category mapping or per-finding record. The benchmark evidence and check-run record as described therefore cannot substantiate AC9 or AC20. Add a concrete per-finding attribution shape, update classifyFindings and benchmark output to carry it, and extend the tests and evidence steps accordingly.

findings.title: Specify how the operator-recorded version-attestation basis is supplied
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11, step 12, and smoke runbook Step 8 require an operator-recorded version-attestation basis for the reported model identity before AC8/AC9 same-configuration claims are admissible. The plan defines no CLI flag, config key, evidence-document field, or other mechanism by which that attestation is recorded or read into the configuration block. Without a source, implementers must guess and the runbook cannot be executed as written. Define the exact attestation input/source, where it is stored, how the benchmark reads it, and how the evidence doc verifies it.

findings.title: State whether benchmark campaign JSON outputs are committed generated artifacts
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 writes campaign results to docs/testing/ronda/sweep-*.json, and step 12 says the evidence document is assembled from those files with no hand transcription. Recorded artifacts lists only the markdown evidence documents. The plan does not say whether the raw JSON files are committed generated artifacts, temporary scratch files, or ignored artifacts. This matters for auditability and for the checklist requirement to call out generated artifacts. State the retention/commitment policy and, if committed, list them as artifacts; if not committed, explain how the evidence figures remain verifiable.

findings.title: Define degraded-record placement for terminal failures after the review request
findings.body: run-review-pass rules 1 and 2 say unrecognized-enablement and invalid-list degraded records are logged and carried into buildCheckRunOutput on the success path, but the plan does not define their surface placement when the pass issues the review request and then fails terminally. Spec AC18 and AC19 put these records on the surfaces AC1 assigns, which means logs-only for a failure check run and logs plus whatever review-outcome check-run surface exists when the review is already public. Add explicit rules and tests for degraded records under post-request terminal failure.

findings.title: Extend the AC14 credential scan beyond the benchmark tree
findings.body: Testing Strategy scenario 7 and Implementation Order step 10 scope the real-credential scan to seeds and committed evidence/fixture files under the benchmark tree. AC14 covers quality evidence produced by this feature, which also includes docs/testing/ronda/sweep-categories.json, sweep-effect-evidence.md, sweep-real-pr-evidence.md, and any committed campaign outputs. Extend the automated scan to all feature-produced evidence artifacts or state a reasoned narrower scope.

findings.title: Make prompt-fingerprint computation concrete
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 requires a prompt fingerprint as a SHA-256 over the composed prompt template with the sweep section excluded, but does not define what counts as the template versus per-fixture dynamic content, how the sweep section is excluded canonically, or how equality is computed across arms. This is necessary for the differ-only-by-sweepMode assertion and for detecting unrelated prompt edits. Specify the exact prompt inputs, normalization, exclusion mechanism, and test strategy.

findings.title: Specify production resolution of the sweep-categories.json path
findings.body: src/review/sweep-categories.ts says production loadSweepList with no argument loads docs/testing/ronda/sweep-categories.json from the repository root or Ronda checkout, but the plan does not state how that root is resolved at runtime (process.cwd, package root, injected checkout path, etc.). This is not a test-only detail because webhook and CLI deployments may run from different working directories. Specify the authoritative path-resolution mechanism and the failure behavior when the artifact is absent.

findings.title: Enumerate the configuration identity block fields
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 says each run's configuration block includes the effective sweepMode, reported model identities, version-attestation basis, operator-config values that shape a pass, and a prompt fingerprint, but only names maxPatchChars and otherwise says the review configuration the pass would resolve. The required test that configuration blocks differ in sweepMode alone cannot be implemented without an exact field list or comparison rule. Enumerate the included fields or define the serialization/comparison precisely.

findings.title: Fix stale step-number cross-references
findings.body: Seed Data says the original-thirteen snapshot is taken before step 9 mutates the live fixture, and smoke runbook Step 8 says it is created in implementation step 9, but Implementation Order step 10 is the fixture-seed step that mutates the fixture. The recall-benchmark bullet says the CLI flags are specified in Implementation Order step 10, but they are specified in step 11. Step 11 also refers to the evidence doc as step 11 when the evidence campaign is step 12. Correct these cross-references so ordering is unambiguous.

findings.title: Remove the claim that default single-run benchmark output remains identical
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 says --runs default 1 keeps today's single-run output identical, but the same step requires unconditional fixture and configuration identity blocks on every run record and adds sweep-conditional fields. The output shape therefore changes even with --runs 1. Either remove the identical-output claim or define a compatibility mode and verify it.

findings.title: Confirm or replace source-file line-number references
findings.body: The Verification Log and Backend/API bullets cite exact source-file line numbers and ranges, including .github/workflows/ronda-review.yml L134–145, src/cli/review-pr.ts L81–90, src/webhook/webhook-job.ts L224–233, src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:475–489, and several test-file line numbers. These numeric references cannot be confirmed from the plan-stage artifacts and may go stale before implementation. Mark them as implementer-confirmed at implementation time or replace them with stable symbolic references.

findings.title: Place the AC17 regression-gate statement consistently
findings.body: Documentation Updates says the AC17 statement belongs in docs/testing/ronda/sweep-effect-evidence.md, but smoke runbook Step 12 opens docs/testing/ronda/sweep-real-pr-evidence.md and expects that statement there. Implementation Order step 12 and step 13 do not clearly assign the AC17 statement to one artifact. Choose one location, update the implementation steps, and align the runbook expectation.

findings.title: Remove or align the extra version field on SweepCategory
findings.body: Backend/API says SweepCategory includes a version field, but the recorded artifact description and SweepCategoryList use a list-level version, and the spec's category fields do not include a per-category version. Remove the per-category version or align the artifact, types, and all references.

findings.title: Mark binding enumerations with the required literal
findings.body: The plan treats several enumerations as binding, such as the five swept categories, the excluded candidate set, and the five new fixture seeds, but none of the introducing lines carries the exact literal **Binding enumeration**. If these enumerations are intended as binding, add the marker immediately above the introducing line; otherwise state that they are indicative.

findings.title: Replace conditional documentation wording with concrete actions
findings.body: Documentation Updates uses conditional wording such as if that file's conventions require it, only if those docs enumerate every review mode, and verify against their current content during implementation. The checklist prefers specific executable steps. Replace each conditional with a concrete check, decision, or explicit declaration that no update is needed and why.

findings.title: Add Matrix coherence preflight row to Document Quality Gate
findings.body: The plan contains a decision-gate matrix and an evidence-tier transition state table, so it has a stateful contract. The PR Document Quality Gate has no Matrix coherence preflight row with the six-check audit summary or a reasoned Not applicable. Add the required row.

findings.title: Add the plan-authoring rigor outcome record
findings.body: The plan has no Plan authoring rigor block. The checklist requires the block to name Rules 1 through 6 by canonical name with one-line triggers, name the Satisfied / Not applicable / Unsatisfied outcome labels, and link plan-authoring-rigor-rules.md. A missing outcome record is blocking.

findings.title: Remove matchTerms from AC19 malformed-list validation
findings.body: Layer-by-Layer src/review/sweep-categories.ts, Testing Strategy scenario 2, and Smoke Step 4 treat missing or empty matchTerms as a malformed list. Spec AC19 enumerates malformed conditions and does not include matchTerms, and AC4 does not require that field. This adds a degradation path the specification does not describe and can reject a list that is valid under AC19.

findings.title: Align degraded-record emission boundary with AC1, AC18, and AC19
findings.body: run-review-pass steps 1 and 2 hold unrecognized-enablement and invalid-list records until the model review request is issued, and Smoke Step 5 asserts no record for failures after changed files are read but before the request. Spec AC1 defines reaching review execution as reading changed files and running the review, and AC18/AC19 require records for a pass that reaches review execution. Reconcile this boundary or the plan leaves specified degraded records unplanned.

findings.title: Define how the version-attestation basis is recorded
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 says each run configuration block carries an operator-recorded version-attestation basis, and step 12 plus Smoke Step 8 make AC8/AC9 admissibility depend on it. No CLI flag, config key, file, or other source defines how the operator records that basis. This cannot be executed without guessing; define the mechanism.

findings.title: Fix Implementation Order step 2 dependency on tests added later
findings.body: Implementation Order step 2 verifies the committed category list by saying the AC6/AC7 assertions of Testing Strategy scenario 8 pass, but scenario 8's unit test file is not added until step 4. Move the test step earlier or change step 2 to a verification that exists at that point.

findings.title: Specify degraded-record handling for benchmark runs
findings.body: AC1 assigns benchmark runs the benchmark output and logs as record surfaces. The benchmark driver section defines only a valid sweep-on per-category record and a sweep-off absence; it does not define benchmark-output handling for unrecognized enablement or an invalid list. Add those degraded-record cases.

findings.title: Specify degraded records for superseded-before-publication passes
findings.body: run-review-pass step 5 says superseded-before-publication passes log their per-category record, but it does not say they log the unrecognized-enablement or invalid-list degraded records. AC18/AC19 assign those records to AC1 surfaces, and a superseded pass has no review-outcome check run, so the logs/own-surface case must be explicit.

findings.title: Make category classification semantics satisfy spec category fit
findings.body: classifyFindings decides category fit by literal substring matchTerms over finding title and body. The spec requires findings that fit swept categories to be recorded against them, and AC15(d) membership is decided against recorded failure shapes. Substring terms can under-attribute or misattribute findings without model category attribution. Define a classification mechanism that can satisfy the spec semantics or add model-provided category attribution.

findings.title: Specify precision runs for the original-fixture control
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 and Smoke Step 9 show paired precision output files only for the extended fixture, while step 11 and Smoke Step 8 also run an original-fixture recall control. Spec Business Rules and AC9 make precision evidence mandatory for every recall comparison. State whether original-fixture precision runs are required and provide commands/output names.

findings.title: Cover all AC19 malformed shapes in Smoke Step 4
findings.body: Smoke Step 4 claims every AC19 variant is tested but omits a non-scalar list version and the no-single-current-list-version-can-be-identified case, while adding matchTerms cases that AC19 does not require. Align the runbook with AC19 and with plan Testing Strategy scenario 2.

findings.title: Fix Assertions Checklist AC1 terminal-failure wording
findings.body: Assertions Checklist AC1 says terminal failures after the request record not_determined on the logs only. Plan step 4 and spec AC1 require post-publication failures to carry ordinary produced_findings / produced_none values and any per-category surface produced by a review-outcome check run. Fix the checklist.

findings.title: Correct the claim that default benchmark output remains identical
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 says --runs default 1 keeps today's single-run output identical, but the same step adds unconditional fixture and configuration identity blocks and sweep-conditional fields to run records. The output shape cannot be identical; correct the statement or make the new fields backward-compatible.

findings.title: Fix step-number cross-references for snapshot and evidence doc
findings.body: Seed Data says the original-thirteen snapshot is taken before step 9 mutates the fixture, Smoke Step 8 says it is created in implementation step 9, and Implementation Order performs the snapshot and seed addition in step 10. Step 11 also calls the evidence doc step 11 although it is step 12. Fix the numeric cross-references.

findings.title: Mark binding enumerations with the required literal
findings.body: The exact five-category list, excluded-candidate set, and five fixture seeds are intended as binding, but no enumeration carries the literal **Binding enumeration** on or immediately above its introduction. Add the marker or explicitly mark those enumerations indicative.

findings.title: Add explicit run-position support for AC11 paired cost metrics
findings.body: AC11's comparative cost metric is paired by run position, but the benchmark output shape only says --runs n emits one record per run and does not specify an explicit run-position field or a stable-order guarantee. Add a run index or state that array order is normative and tested.

findings.title: Confirm or mark unverified source-line and behavior claims
findings.body: The plan cites source-file behavior and line references such as workflow L134-145, review-pr L81-90, webhook-job L224-233, and recall-benchmark.ts:475-489. These are not confirmed by the Verification Log entries and cannot be checked from the plan alone; mark them unverified or confirm them before implementation.

findings.title: Name exact fixture seed paths
findings.body: Seed Data gives fixture paths as src/benchmark/git-history.ts or similar for several seeds. The implementation steps should name exact fixture paths or a deterministic naming rule to avoid guessing.

findings.title: Remove or explain per-category version field
findings.body: Domain types say SweepCategory includes a version, but the recorded artifact and spec only define a list-level version. Remove the per-category version or explain where it comes from to avoid cross-section inconsistency.

findings.title: Align gate-count wording with the spec
findings.body: The Document Quality Gate says the item adds five decision gates and one pass-outcome rule, while the spec's decision-gate matrix says four decision gates and one pass-outcome rule. Align the classification.

findings.title: Add Matrix coherence preflight to the Document Quality Gate
findings.body: The plan contains a stateful contract: a decision-gate matrix, enablement precedence rules, evidence-tier transitions, and pass-outcome surface rules. The PR's Document Quality Gate log has no `Matrix coherence preflight` row with the six-check audit summary or a reasoned `Not applicable`. Add the required row; a missing row is blocking for a plan with this kind of stateful contract.

findings.title: Add the required plan authoring rigor block
findings.body: The plan has no plan authoring rigor outcome record. The required block must name all six rules by canonical name in the form `Rule N — <canonical name>: <one-line trigger>`, name the three outcome labels, and link `docs/workflow/development-workflow/plan-authoring-rigor-rules.md` without restating pass conditions. A missing outcome record is blocking.

findings.title: Align degraded-record emission boundary with AC1, AC18, and AC19
findings.body: `run-review-pass.ts` steps 1–2 and Smoke Test Step 5 hold unrecognized-enablement and invalid-list degraded records until the pass issues a review request. Spec AC1 says a terminal failure after the changed files are read is a pass that reached review execution, and AC18/AC19 require the degraded record for a pass that reaches review execution. The plan's narrower request-issuance boundary therefore contradicts the spec for failures such as an authoritative-document fetch after changed-file read but before model call. Reconcile the boundary or cite the exact spec text that changes it.

findings.title: Define degraded-record surfaces for superseded passes
findings.body: Step 5 says superseded-before-publication passes log their per-category record, but it does not say what happens to the unrecognized-enablement or invalid-list `SweepDegradedRecord` when a degraded pass is superseded after reaching review execution. AC1 assigns logs for completion without a review-outcome check run, and AC18/AC19 put degraded records on the AC1 surfaces. Add the missing superseded degraded-record case and test coverage.

findings.title: Define how the model version-attestation basis is recorded
findings.body: The model identity seam and Step 11 make AC8/AC9 admissibility depend on an operator-recorded version-attestation basis, but no flag, config key, evidence-document field, runbook input, or output-field source is defined. Without a concrete recording mechanism, the required same-immutable-model evidence cannot be produced or tested as written. Specify where the attestation comes from and how the benchmark/configuration block obtains it.

findings.title: Resolve contradictory AC17 documentation location
findings.body: Documentation Updates says the AC17 statement belongs in `docs/testing/ronda/sweep-effect-evidence.md`, while Smoke Test Step 12 expects the same statement in `docs/testing/ronda/sweep-real-pr-evidence.md`. Implementation Order step 13 does not explicitly add the AC17 statement to either file. Choose one normative location and make the implementation step, smoke expectation, and documentation list agree.

findings.title: Correct the decision-gate count in the Document Quality Gate
findings.body: The Document Quality Gate says the item adds five decision gates and one pass-outcome rule. The spec says four decision gates and one pass-outcome rule, and the plan's own matrix contains five total rows. Fix the count or explain the classification so the gate log is not contradictory.

findings.title: Justify or remove the `default` enablement alias
findings.body: AC18 requires the same on/off vocabulary as the existing durability-mode switch and lists recognized on/off outcomes. The plan adds an explicit `default` alias for `off`, and Smoke Step 3 treats `default` as recognized off with no record. If `default` is not part of the spec's on/off vocabulary, this is unplanned behavior; if it is part of the durability vocabulary, state that explicitly. Otherwise treat non-empty `default` as unrecognized.

findings.title: Do not map `matchTerms` validation to AC19 without spec basis
findings.body: The plan makes `matchTerms` a required category-list field and treats missing or invalid `matchTerms` as AC19 malformed. Spec AC19's malformed conditions and AC4's required category fields do not include `matchTerms`. Either mark this as an additional planning validation with its own degraded semantics, or remove it from the AC19 gate and tests.

findings.title: State whether `--manifest` and `--patches` benchmark flags exist or must be added
findings.body: Step 11 and Smoke Step 8 use `--manifest` and `--patches` for the original-thirteen control, but Implementation Order step 11 only adds `--sweep-mode`, `--runs`, and `--output-file`. The plan does not say whether the manifest/patches flags already exist. If they do not, the implementation order is missing required CLI work and tests; if they do, cite the existing surface.

findings.title: Expand compressed evidence-tier and claim-admissibility matrix rows
findings.body: The plan's Decision-gate matrix compresses the spec's evidence-tier and claim-admissibility rows and omits required details such as revision at `fixture_only` leaving the tier unchanged, revision at `real_pr_provisional` restarting the count without tier change, cohort closure before adjudication, terminal adjudication requirements, precision-evidence pairing for recall claims, and zero-denominator handling. These omissions force the implementer to guess at the spec's stateful contract. Reproduce the missing cases or reference the exact spec rows normatively.

findings.title: Reassess the concurrency not-applicable rationale
findings.body: The Concurrent-event-source addendum says no new listener, timer, or async queue is added. Step 11 explicitly moves the benchmark `AbortController`/`passTimeoutMs` timer into a per-run loop and the precision fixtures run concurrently through `Promise.all`. Either provide the dedicated concurrency safety section addressing the seven checklist items, or give a reasoned not-applicable explanation that covers these timer and async-boundary changes.

findings.title: Reconcile parser-risk rationale with substring classification and credential scanning
findings.body: The Parser-risk addendum says there is no regex-driven structured-text scanning. However `classifyFindings` performs literal substring scanning over finding text, and Testing Strategy scenario 7 adds a credential-shape scan over fixture and evidence files using pattern-like rules. findings.title: Verify codebase and line-number claims before implementation

findings.title: Add Matrix coherence preflight row to Document Quality Gate
findings.body: The plan contains a stateful contract: a decision-gate matrix, operator-config precedence rules, evidence-tier transitions, and claim-admissibility rules. The PR Document Quality Gate log therefore must carry a 'Matrix coherence preflight' row with the six-check audit summary or a reasoned Not applicable. That row is missing.

findings.title: Correct decision-gate count in Document Quality Gate
findings.body: The Document Quality Gate says this item adds five decision gates and one pass-outcome rule, while the spec says four decision gates and one pass-outcome rule. The plan matrix has five rows including the pass-outcome surface assignment row. Reconcile the count so the gate log is not contradictory.

findings.title: Add plan-authoring rigor outcome record
findings.body: The plan has no plan-authoring-rigor outcome record. The required block must name all six rules by canonical name, name the three outcome labels, link plan-authoring-rigor-rules.md, and record a per-rule outcome or Not applicable rationale. A missing outcome record is blocking.

findings.title: Plan degraded sweep records only on logs, omitting check-run output
findings.body: Layer-by-Layer Changes and Implementation Order log 'sweep-did-not-run' and unrecognized-enablement records, but the summary renderer changes only add a SweepPassRecord to check-run output. Spec Operational Visibility says both degraded records are carried on the same AC1-assigned surfaces, which includes the check-run output when the pass's check-run outcome is a review. Define check-run fields for these records and test them.

findings.title: Define per-finding category attribution in classifier and outputs
findings.body: classifyFindings is specified to return only per-category outcomes and an uncategorized count. AC20 requires every published finding to appear in the per-category record as categorized or uncategorized, and AC9 requires each sweep-on unexpected finding to be attributed to its category/categories/uncategorized. The plan must define a finding-to-category mapping and include per-finding attribution or identifiable uncategorized entries in the relevant surfaces.

findings.title: Specify initial matchTerms instead of referencing spec values that do not exist
findings.body: Recorded artifacts, validation, classification, and tests all depend on matchTerms, but the spec Statuses / Enum Values table does not fix matchTerms. Implementation Order step 2 says the artifact values are exactly as the spec fixes them, which is impossible for matchTerms. Define the concrete initial matchTerms or an unambiguous derivation rule.

findings.title: Do not make missing matchTerms a spec-AC19 malformed case without authority
findings.body: The validator and Smoke Step 4 treat missing/empty/non-string matchTerms as malformed, but AC19's malformed definition does not include matchTerms among required category fields. Either justify this as a necessary parsing detail under the plan's storage decision or align the malformed enumeration with the spec.

findings.title: Make per-category benchmark record conditional on sweep-on runs
findings.body: Implementation Order step 10 says each run's record carries the per-category pass record and its verification says both configurations' summaries have the per-category record. A sweep-off run has no sweep pass record under the spec and under the plan's own degraded-path description. Clarify that the per-category record appears only for sweep-on runs and adjust the output shape and verification.

findings.title: Cover post-publication terminal-failure outcome in runbook assertions
findings.body: Assertions Checklist AC1 says terminal failures after execution record not_determined on the logs only. The plan and spec require ordinary produced_findings/produced_none values when the failure occurs after the review is already public. Update the runbook and the plan's test scenario to distinguish pre-publication and post-publication terminal failures.

findings.title: Verify or plan CLI flags and fixture paths used by campaign legs
findings.body: Step 10 and Smoke Step 8 rely on --manifest/--patches for the original-fixture control and --precision-response-file for precision runs, but Implementation Order only adds --sweep-mode, --runs, and --output-file. The plan does not verify that the other flags exist or specify where the original fixture files live after the extended manifest is committed. Confirm existing support or add explicit implementation steps.

findings.title: Specify how the original-thirteen subset is reported
findings.body: AC8 requires the original thirteen seeded defects to be reported as a separate subset alongside the extended fixture. Step 10's output shape only adds existing recall fields, per-category record, model-call count, and elapsed time, with no mechanism for an original-thirteen subset breakdown. Define the subset reporting mechanism in the benchmark output or evidence assembly.

findings.title: Evidence campaign step omits AC9 pairing fields
findings.body: Implementation Order step 11 does not explicitly require the evidence document to record the category-list version and effective review configuration used by the precision runs. AC9 requires both. Add these fields to the evidence-campaign requirements.

findings.title: Evidence campaign step omits AC11 comparative cost metric
findings.body: Step 11 says cost figures are compared, but it does not name AC11's required comparative benchmark metric: per-run differences in model calls and elapsed time paired by run position and averaged across runs. Smoke Step 10 has the metric, but the implementation evidence step should state it too.

findings.title: State whether benchmark JSON output artifacts are committed or retained
findings.body: The campaign commands write JSON output files that the evidence document is assembled from, and the plan says no run is hand-transcribed. The plan does not say whether those JSON artifacts are committed, retained, or ephemeral. State their artifact status so the evidence chain is auditable.

findings.title: Expand claim-admissibility decision-gate row
findings.body: The Decision-gate matrix claim-admissibility row is too abbreviated to implement or test. It omits the spec's cohort-closure-before-results requirement, terminal-adjudication requirement, membership-recording-before-claim requirement, equal-run-count requirement, variance minimum of two runs per configuration, population-standard-deviation metric, and per-head cost reduction before averaging. Expand the row or explicitly incorporate those AC15(d) checks.

findings.title: Reassess parser-risk addendum for substring classification
findings.body: The Parser-risk addendum says no structured-text scanning, but classifyFindings scans normalized finding title/body text for literal substring matchTerms. If the protocol's parser-risk signals apply to this kind of deterministic text classification, the addendum must cover it or provide a reasoned rationale. Reconcile the addendum with the planned classifier.

findings.title: Source-file line numbers and codebase behavior claims are not supported in the plan
findings.body: The plan cites source-file line numbers and behavior for .github/workflows/ronda-review.yml, src/cli/review-pr.ts, src/webhook/webhook-job.ts, tests, parseDurabilityMode, and buildCheckRunOutput. These numeric cross-references and behavior claims cannot be confirmed from the plan diff. Remove stale-prone line numbers or mark each such claim as unverified — implementer must confirm before proceeding.

findings.title: Add explicit step to update full RondaConfig literals
findings.body: Layer-by-Layer Changes says full RondaConfig literals in src/cli/review-pr.ts, src/webhook/webhook-job.ts, and tests must gain sweepMode/sweepModeRaw or typecheck fails, but Implementation Order step 1 adds the required fields without explicitly updating those literals. Later typecheck verification can fail or force guessing. Add an explicit step to update all full config literals.

findings.title: Seed data paths and representative fixtures are vague
findings.body: Seed Data uses paths such as 'src/benchmark/git-history.ts or similar' and refers to representative finding fixtures without naming them or defining how they are chosen. This leaves implementation details to guessing. Specify exact fixture paths, response fixtures, or a deterministic selection rule.

findings.title: Mark binding enumerations with the required literal
findings.body: Enumerations that appear binding, such as the five swept categories, the five new seeds, and the malformed-list shapes, do not carry the exact literal **Binding enumeration** on or immediately above the introducing line. Add the marker or make clear the enumerations are indicative.

findings.title: Remove or clarify version field on SweepCategory
findings.body: Domain types give SweepCategory a version field, while the recorded artifact and spec carry version at the list level. This creates a term with two possible meanings. Remove the per-category version or clarify that it is the list version copied into the category.

findings.title: Replace conditional documentation updates with explicit decisions
findings.body: Documentation Updates uses conditional wording such as 'if that file's conventions require it', 'only if those docs enumerate every review mode', and 'unless the developer adds a benchmark:sweep script'. The checklist asks for documentation updates to be listed or intentionally declared unnecessary. Make each target an explicit decision.

findings.title: Specify --runs output shape
findings.body: Step 10 says --runs 2 yields two per-run records in one file, but does not define the JSON shape: array of run records, wrapped object, or extension of the current summary. Define the shape so evidence assembly and tests are not guessed.

findings.title: Clarify benchmark --sweep-mode precedence over environment/config
findings.body: Step 10 says the benchmark --sweep-mode flag is the benchmark's only sweep switch while also saying the pass's own env/config resolution is unchanged. The interaction when RONDA_SWEEP_MODE or a config-file value is present is unspecified. State whether the flag overrides, ignores, or merges with existing configuration.

findings.title: Include list version in sweep log event description
findings.body: Implementation Order step 5 logs a sweep_pass_record event with the per-category record, but does not state that the log event includes the list version. Spec Operational Visibility requires logs to record that the sweep ran and the list version. Add the list version to the event description.

findings.title: Remove stale Open Questions and awaiting-human sections
findings.body: The PR description says all open questions were answered on 2026-09-26 and the Open Questions section was removed, but the spec still contains Open Questions and AWAITING HUMAN PRODUCT DECISIONS stating that implementation cannot proceed. Update the spec to the confirmed decisions and remove or replace these sections with decided behavior or deferred-decision records.

findings.title: Correct stale Document Quality Gate log
findings.body: The PR Document Quality Gate claims internal consistency, deleted Open Questions, and a decision-gate matrix section, but the spec contradicts those claims. Update the gate log after fixing the spec; a log that claims checked coverage while the spec contains unresolved open questions and missing matrix evidence is blocking.

findings.title: Add missing decision-gate consistency matrix
findings.body: The PR gate says a Decision-gate consistency matrix section exists, but the spec has no such section. The spec adds enablement resolution, category-list readability, pass-outcome surface assignment, evidence-tier transitions, and claim admissibility gates. Add the matrix or pointer with gate inputs, allowed outcomes, required next actions, mirror surfaces, and examples.

findings.title: Add Matrix coherence preflight row
findings.body: The spec contains stateful constructs such as evidence-tier transitions and decision gates, so the PR Document Quality Gate needs a Matrix coherence preflight row with the six-check audit summary or a reasoned Not applicable. That row is absent. Add it after the matrix evidence is corrected.

findings.title: Make initial category list current using confirmed exclusions
findings.body: Statuses / Enum Values leaves spec-AC-compliance and per-finding resolution awaiting human decision and says the list cannot be marked current, while the PR confirms both are excluded. Use Case 1 and AC4/AC6 require a current recorded list. Move both candidates to Excluded candidates with the confirmed rationales and state that the initial list can be current.

findings.title: Define confirmed per-category pass record surfaces
findings.body: Operational Visibility still calls the per-category pass-record surface an open question, and AC1/AC20 only say operator-facing evidence surface. The confirmed decision names check-run output and logs plus benchmark output. Name the normative surfaces so AC1 and AC20 are testable.

findings.title: Reconcile benchmark gate restoration with deferred pass/fail contract
findings.body: AC17 says the seeded benchmark gate is restored once AC12 and AC13 cases exist, but the PR deferred decision says the pass/fail contract for a restored gate is not decided and no benchmark run passes or fails until then. Either define the pass/fail contract, or make AC17 say the fixture becomes a gate basis only without pass/fail behavior.

findings.title: Add Deferred Decisions section
findings.body: The PR description says deferred decisions are recorded in the spec's Deferred Decisions table, but the spec has no such section. Add a table recording the recall/variance threshold, cost ceiling, restored-gate pass/fail contract, and default-flip decision with owners and triggers.

findings.title: Remove stale open-question references from normative clauses
findings.body: Business Rules, Evidence tier, Use Case 6, AC15, and Deferral Note D1 still refer to Open Questions 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9 or request confirmation despite the PR saying those decisions are confirmed. Replace those references with the confirmed decisions so normative requirements are not conditional on closed questions.

findings.title: Define recognized sweep enablement values
findings.body: AC18 requires off for empty or unrecognized values but does not define the recognized on/off values or the concrete key. Without the allowed value set, the unrecognized-value behavior cannot be tested. Define the allowed values or point to the existing operator-configuration contract that defines them.

findings.title: Clarify AC10 clean result versus uncategorized findings
findings.body: AC10 says a pass that finds nothing for every swept category publishes a clean result, while AC20 permits findings to be recorded as uncategorized. State whether a pass with only uncategorized findings is clean for AC10, or define clean as no published findings at all.

findings.title: Clarify provisional tier counting with adjudication
findings.body: The confirmed decision says a pull request Ronda merely reviewed does not count, but the evidence-tier transition moves Fixture evidence only to provisional on the first sweep-enabled review and AC15(b) uses no review recorded. Clarify whether unadjudicated reviews count toward provisional status and the ten-pull-request total, and make Use Case 6, the enum, and AC15 consistent.

findings.title: State list-revision restart for provisional tier in AC15
findings.body: The evidence-tier transitions say a revision while provisional leaves the tier provisional and restarts the pull-request count, but AC15(c) only relabels measured evidence. Extend AC15(c) to require the restart for provisional evidence too.

findings.title: Specify where unrecognized or degraded sweep states are recorded
findings.body: AC18 requires recording an unrecognized enablement value and AC19 requires recording that the sweep did not run, but neither says on which surface. Operational Visibility only says logs may record sweep information. Name the required operator-facing surface or log field so these records are testable.

findings.title: Define adjudicated external-finding evidence
findings.body: AC15, Business Rules, and Use Case 6 gate the measured tier on adjudicated external-finding evidence, but the spec does not define adjudication criteria or the record that proves it. Define the term or reference the dependency that establishes it.

findings.title: Clarify same configuration for sweep-on and sweep-off comparisons
findings.body: Use Cases 3 and 4 and the Business Rules require the same configuration while comparing sweep-on and sweep-off runs, but the sweep enablement setting itself differs. State that all configuration except the sweep enablement switch must be identical.

findings.title: Cite explicit evidence sources for initial categories
findings.body: AC4 requires each category to state its supporting real-pull-request evidence source, but the initial category table only gives evidence identifiers and counts. Add the explicit source artifact or path for each initial category so the list is traceable without relying on the PR description.

findings.title: Define matched sweep-off control collection
findings.body: Use Case 6 and the confirmed decision require a matched sweep-off control on the same pull request heads for comparative claims, but the spec does not say how that control is produced, recorded, or kept unpublished without conflicting with the one-review-per-head rule. Define the control record or describe it as an offline/shadow comparison.

findings.title: Define behavior when no category list is marked current
findings.body: Use Case 1 requires a current list, and Business Rules say exactly one list is current, but the spec does not say what happens when sweep is enabled and no list version is marked current. State whether this is treated as unreadable/malformed and degrades to a non-sweep review, or define another safe behavior.

findings.title: Reconcile check-run surface with out-of-scope check-run behavior
findings.body: The confirmed per-category pass-record surface includes check-run output, while Out of Scope says changing check-run behavior is out of scope. Clarify that adding operator-facing information to an existing check-run surface is not a behavior change, or adjust the out-of-scope statement.

findings.title: Clarify two gating tests wording
findings.body: The Business Rules say only two tests are gating for default enablement but then list recall, variance, precision, and cost evidence plus precision non-regression. Rephrase to name the exact gating conditions.
